arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib,hashlib
m=importlib.import_module('stackprinter.frame_formatting')
actual=Path(m.__file__).resolve();expected=(Path.cwd()/'stackprinter/frame_formatting.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, textwrap
probe = textwrap.dedent('''
    import sys
    import stackprinter
    def inner():
        marker = 7
        raise ValueError('colormark')
    def outer():
        inner()
    try:
        outer()
    except ValueError:
        out = stackprinter.format(sys.exc_info(), style='darkbg')
    has_marker = 'marker' in out
    has_msg = 'colormark' in out
    print('color', has_marker, has_msg)
    assert has_marker and has_msg, out[-1500:]
''')
fd, p = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.py')
os.write(fd, probe.encode())
os.close(fd)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, p], capture_output=True, text=True)
os.unlink(p)
print(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if r.stdout.strip() else 'no-probe-output')
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[-1000:]
assert 'color True True' in r.stdout, r.stdout[-500:]
